queryText:
SELECT id, name, slug, price, image, images, category, category_slug,
               short_description, is_best_seller, is_live, is_custom_request,
               custom_form_config, default_form_fields, variants, hub,
               is_affiliate_eligible, affiliate_commission_rate, affiliate_payout_type,
               affiliate_fixed_amount, min_affiliate_level, avg_rating, reviews_count,
               gst_rate, normalized_name, normalized_category, normalized_description,
               created_at, CASE
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%coffee mug%' THEN 'coffee mug'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%tea cup%' THEN 'tea cup'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%gift hamper%' THEN 'gift hamper'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%soap holder%' THEN 'soap holder'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%soap%' THEN 'soap'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%necklace%' THEN 'necklace'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%planter%' THEN 'planter'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%mug%' THEN 'mug'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%cup%' THEN 'cup'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END AS primary_product_type,
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN normalized_name = $1 THEN 1000
                        WHEN normalized_name LIKE $2 THEN 900
                        WHEN (normalized_name LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%set%') THEN 800
                        WHEN normalized_name LIKE $3 THEN 700
                        WHEN FALSE THEN 500
                        WHEN FALSE THEN 400
                        WHEN (normalized_category LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%set%') THEN 300
                        WHEN (normalized_description LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%set%') THEN 100
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) + CASE WHEN CASE
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%coffee mug%' THEN 'coffee mug'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%tea cup%' THEN 'tea cup'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%gift hamper%' THEN 'gift hamper'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%soap holder%' THEN 'soap holder'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%soap%' THEN 'soap'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%necklace%' THEN 'necklace'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%planter%' THEN 'planter'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%mug%' THEN 'mug'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE '%cup%' THEN 'cup'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END = 'gift hamper' THEN 150 ELSE 0 END + 0 AS relevance,
                CASE
                    WHEN normalized_name = $1 THEN 'Exact Name'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE $2 THEN 'Starts With Name'
                    WHEN (normalized_name LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%set%') THEN 'All Tokens In Name'
                    WHEN normalized_name LIKE $3 THEN 'Contains Name'
                    WHEN FALSE THEN 'SKU'
                    WHEN FALSE THEN 'Tags'
                    WHEN (normalized_category LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%set%') THEN 'Category'
                    WHEN (normalized_description LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_description LIKE '%set%') THEN 'Description'
                    ELSE 'Other'
                END AS matched_field FROM products WHERE (
                    normalized_name = $1
                    OR normalized_name LIKE $2
                    OR (normalized_name LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_name LIKE '%set%')
                    OR normalized_name LIKE $3
                    OR FALSE
                    OR FALSE
                    OR (normalized_category LIKE '%eco%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%friendly%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%kitchen%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%gift%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%hamper%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%handmade%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%coconut%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%shell%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%bowl%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%spoon%' AND normalized_category LIKE '%set%')
                ) AND is_live = TRUE ORDER BY relevance DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
